mapper.select: select * from students where sxid=#{sxid} and spwd=#{spwd}
select semail from students where sxid=${sxid}
mapper.update: update students set spwd=#{spwd} where sxid=#{sxid}
mapper.select: select c.* from clazz c inner join academy a on c.acacademyid=a.aid where a.aname=#{aname}
mapper.insert: insert into students(sxid, spwd, sname, ssex, semail, sacademy, sclass, remain1, remain2) values(#{sxid}, #{spwd}, #{sname}, '男', #{semail}, #{sacademy}, #{sclass}, null, null)
mapper.select: select sid from students where sname=#{sname}
mapper.update: update students set ssex=#{ssex} where sid=#{sid}
mapper.insert: insert into enrollmsg(sid, epicture, enation, eidentif, ebirthday, ework, eaddr, ephone, remain1, remain2) values(#{sid}, #{epicture}, #{enation}, #{eidentif}, #{ebirthday}, #{ework}, #{eaddr}, #{ephone}, null, null)
mapper.select: select distinct(eid) from enrollmsg where sid=#{sid}
select teid from testclas where tename=#{tename} order by teid desc limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into computest(eid, teid, cstatus, cotid, cotclass, cottask) values(#{eid}, #{teid}, '待审核', null, null, null)
mapper.select: select teid from computest where eid=#{eid}
select tename from testclas where teid=#{teid}
select cstatus from computest where eid=#{eid}

select co.cid, st.sname, en.epicture, st.ssex, st.sclass, en.enation, en.eidentif, en.ephone, te.tename, co.cstatus, nl.nocontent from computest co left join enrollmsg en on co.eid=en.eid left join students st on en.sid=st.sid left join testclas te on co.teid=te.teid left join academy ac on st.sacademy=ac.aname left join notThrowLog nl on co.cid=nl.cid where st.sid=#{sid} ORDER BY co.cid DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT ea.roomName, ea.seatNumber, ea.examDate, ea.examTime FROM examAssignment ea JOIN computest c ON ea.cid = c.cid JOIN enrollmsg e ON c.eid = e.eid WHERE e.sid = #{sid}
